positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Frontend lead for LinkedIn Premium

- Led development of LinkedIn Premium experiences across web, iOS, Android, and mobile web, supporting millions of subscribers worldwide
- Technical leader in LinkedIn’s migration to server-driven UI architecture, improving development velocity and reducing client-side implementation complexity
- Drove cross-functional initiatives involving 5+ engineers across engineering, product, design, and data science, delivering high-impact subscriber growth and retention features
- Defined experimentation strategy and analyzed A/B test results to optimize conversion funnels, subscriber engagement, and retention metrics
- Mentored engineers and influenced frontend architecture, engineering standards, and code quality across the Premium organization
- Received the org-wide Culture Champion award 2x for spearheading a culture committee that organized numerous events for 100+ employees

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led UI development of key features for Adobe Analytics including Anomaly Detection, Contribution Analysis, Scheduled Projects, Cohort Table, and Component Manager
- Helped transition the product from AngularJS to React
- Prototyped new features
- Technologies used: Javascript, React, Jasmine, Cypress

projects.title: Recipesaurus
projects.description: Recipesaurus is a digital recipe management platform and app designed to help users save, organize, and import family recipes or online dishes from any URL into a single centralized cookbook.
